release_notes:
1. Universal Theme Independence: Completely eliminated all DOM scraping, class listeners, and HTML text parsing across all ecommerce events.
2. Cart Delta Engine: Authoritatively tracks add_to_cart and remove_from_cart via mathematical cart state diffing and core controller network interception.
3. Omitted fragile select_item link scraping in favor of clean catalog separation (view_item_list and view_item).
4. Native blockwishlist support and backend-hydrated checkout carrier and payment tracking.
